description: This file defines the Api model class for the 'user' component in the OpenCart catalog system. It provides methods to retrieve API details by username, fetch IP records associated with an API, and log API call history into the database.
external_files: database connection and query handling via $this->db

classes.name: Api
classes.description: Model class for handling API-related database operations for user APIs in Opencart.

methods.name: getApiByUsername
methods.description: Retrieves API details from the database based on the provided username.

methods.name: getIps
methods.description: Fetches IP records associated with a given API ID.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Logs an API call attempt, including caller, IP, and timestamp, into the history table.
